title: Quarterly private/VPC runway with OKR-linked failure budgets and tranche scheduling
creator: Amelia Torres
description:
Summary: This ticket defines the quarterly runway for Private/VPC/on-prem feature deliveries with explicit OKR-linked failure budgets and tranche-based scheduling. Goal is to produce an operational playbook that ties feature rollout tranches to objective signals (stability, latency %ile, cost delta) and failure budget consumption so that stakeholders can make deterministic go/no-go decisions and trigger contingency lanes automatically.

Background: Customers requiring Private or VPC deployments expect predictable activation windows and clear rollback/patch paths. Past launches have suffered from ad-hoc gating when incidents consumed more of the failure budget than anticipated. We need a repeatable cadence that maps OKRs to measurable signals and defines tranche thresholds that unlock subsequent cohorts.

Deliverables: 
- Tranche definition matrix (cohort size, telemetry gates, rollback criteria, allowed latency and error SLO headroom).
- Failure budget model tied to product OKRs (e.g., availability, 99th latency, token cost deviation).
- Runbook templates: canary, dark-launch, canary-to-tranche promotion, and emergency off-ramp.
- Acceptance criteria and dashboard panels in Console for tranche signals (time to rollback, error spike detection, unit cost regression).
- Communications checklist for customers and CSMs (upgrade window notice, preflight checklist).

Progress updates: 
- 2026-03-05: Kickoff with Eng, SRE, Security, Support. Aligned on primary OKRs and target cohorts (SMB pilot, mid-market 5-10 tenants, enterprise pilot).
- 2026-03-08: Initial failure budget model drafted; SRE suggested moving from fixed-token budgets to proportional budget based on active sessions. See PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/private-runway-prd (internal).
- 2026-03-10: Capacity worksheet completed by infra; recommended tranche sizes scaled to Dedicated capacity lanes. Spreadsheet: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/private-capacity (internal).
- 2026-03-12: Security review flagged KMS rotation window as a potential blocker for tranche B and C; action assigned to ENG-1842 to scope mitigation.
- 2026-03-14: PM review with Sales and CSMs: refined communications cadence and customer-facing SLA language.

Open decisions & trade-offs: 
- Trade-off A: aggressive tranches shorten time-to-value but increase risk of correlated incidents. We propose a hybrid approach: small quick-launch tranche for low-risk customers, followed by larger tranches once telemetry stabilizes.
- Trade-off B: strict cost regression gates could block valuable feature rollouts for customers with atypical token profiles. We'll allow an opt-in override with CSM approval but keep it off-by-default.

Risks & mitigations: 
- Risk: KMS rotation causing transient failures on some on-prem installs. Mitigation: feature-gate KMS rotation and add preflight checks; dependency on ENG-1842 to deliver hotfix.
- Risk: Insufficient observability for per-tenant failure budget. Mitigation: add tranche-level dashboards and alert rules; ENG to instrument aggregated counters before canary.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Tranche matrix and runbooks ratified by SRE and Security.
- Failure budget model documented and simulated against last 6 months of telemetry.
- Console dashboard panels created: tranche health, failure budget burn-rate, rollback action button linked to runbook.
- Pilot rollout to at least 2 customers with roll-forward/rollback executed successfully in staging.

Stakeholder feedback & next steps: 
- SRE: requested a simulation of burn-rate scenarios (assigned to Ravi).
- Security: requested KMS mitigation plan and timeline (blocker for tranche C).
- Sales/CSM: asked for templated customer comms and a vendor-facing acceptance form.

Links & artifacts: 
- PRD (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/private-runway-prd (internal)
- Capacity worksheet: https://drive.redwood.ai/private-capacity (internal)
- Staging dashboard prototype: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/PrivateTranches (internal)
- Related Linear tickets: ENG-1842 (KMS rotation), PM-27415 (private-deploy-waves-runbook), PM-74216 (q2-private-release-waves).

Owner notes: Ravi to produce SRE simulation by 2026-03-22. PM will schedule cross-functional readout 2026-03-24 to approve tranche gating thresholds. If KMS mitigation slips beyond 2026-04-05, tranche C will be postponed and contingency lane activated.

QA checklist (short): 
- [ ] All runbooks uploaded to runbooks.redwood.ai and linked.
- [ ] Dashboards show expected burn-rate scenarios.
- [ ] CSM comms templates reviewed by Legal.
- [ ] Canary promotion automation tested in staging.

This ticket should remain open until the pilot tranche completes and runbook + dashboards are validated in production-like workload. Any changes to tranche thresholds after pilot require a minor PRD update and re-approval from SRE and Security.
